description: This file defines the DictionaryProvider class, which is a ContentProvider implementation for accessing a dictionary database in an Android application. It handles search, suggestion, and shortcut refresh queries related to dictionary words and definitions.

classes.name: DictionaryProvider
classes.description: An Android ContentProvider that supplies dictionary entries for searching, suggestions, and shortcut refresh in a searchable dictionary app.

methods.name: buildUriMatcher
methods.description: Constructs a UriMatcher with specific URI patterns for searching words, getting definitions, and suggestions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the DictionaryDatabase instance when the ContentProvider is created.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Handles various search and suggestion queries based on matching URIs, delegates to specific methods accordingly.

methods.name: getSuggestions
methods.description: Returns suggestion cursors for search queries based on input.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Returns cursors with search results for a given query.

methods.name: getWord
methods.description: Retrieves a specific word and its definition by URI.

methods.name: refreshShortcut
methods.description: Handles shortcut refresh requests to update suggestions.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for the given URI.
